name: follow-tracker
description: Extension Manifest V3 con CSV por captura, dashboard local e historial comparable por persona, fecha y reporte.

scripts.check: node --check extension/core.js && node --check extension/history.js && node --check extension/export-policy.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/dashboard.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8'))" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); for (const p of Object.values(m.icons || {})) if (!fs.existsSync('extension/'+p)) throw new Error('Falta icono: '+p)"
